description: Sets a feedback request to open, in_progress, done, or wont_do. Use it after fixing a request (done) or deciding not to (wont_do). After fixing a request, mark it done with update_feedback_status and a short note saying what changed (the client gets it by email). Marking done emails the client; only mark done once the fix is in the code (and deployed, if the user says so).

resolutionNote.description: Short note for done or wont_do, e.g. "Updated the opening hours on the contact page."

name: update_feedback_status
title: Update feedback status
